normal: are round with a smooth, flat surface and have centered, unlit wicks. They appear uniformly white and are housed in circular metal containers.
chunk-of-wax-missing: presence of small holes or pits on any part of the candle's surface, excluding the edges
damaged-corner-of-packaging: small chips or pits located specifically along the edges of the candle
different-colour-spot: presence of visible stains or discolorations on the surface of the candle, as indicated by red spots or marks that deviate from the uniform color
foreign-particals-on-candle: presence of foreign particles or debris embedded on the surface of the candle, which may appear as dirt or specks disrupting the smooth texture
wax-melded-out-of-the-candle: irregular smears or deformations on the surface of the candle, particularly evident by streaks or uneven texture

normal: smooth, uniform surface, free of any air bubbles, dark spots, scratches, or deformations. The capsules exhibit consistent coloring and are correctly shaped.
bubble: presence of air bubble within the capsule
bubble-discolor: presence of a dark spot in one capsule
bubble-discolor-scratch: presence of a scratch marks on the surface of one of the capsules
bubble-discolor-scratch-leak: presence of leakage of encapsulated material or punctures, squeezing, or structural deformities in a capsule

normal: a smooth, crescent-shaped surface with a uniform beige color and no visible irregularities or damage. It displays a consistent texture and retains its characteristic curved form without any marks or defects.
burnt: slightly darker or blackened spot on the surface of the cashew
same-colour-spot: a small, subtle patch on the cashew that is slightly different in color but blends closely with the natural hue
corner-or-edge-breakage: section of the cashew nut's edge is visibly missing or chipped off
small-hole: a small, pretty deep, circular hole can be seen, piercing through the nut
small-scratches: tiny, fine lines or scratches that don't penetrate deeply but may be challenging to observe against the beige background

normal: has a smooth, even surface with uniform edges and corners. It exhibits a consistent color and texture throughout, with no visible cracks, chunks missing, or discolorations. The overall appearance is polished and symmetrical
chunk-of-gum-missing: noticeable indentation or cavity in the middle of the chewing gum, leading to an uneven texture
chunk-of-gum-missing_small-cracks: combination of a chunk missing and several fine cracks radiating from the missing part
corner-missing: small section missing from one of the corners, giving the gum an irregular corner shape
similar-colour-spot: small, subtle spot on the gum's surface, with a slightly different texture or color, making it look like a minor blemish

normal: A perfect fryum with no visible irregularities, breakages, or color spots, maintaining its intended uniform shape and color.
different-colour-spot: presence of irregular color patches on the fryum. These spots can vary widely in color from darker hues like red to lighter shades similar to the fryum's base color
fryum-stuck-together: two individual fryums become inseparably fused together. It results in an irregular, combined shape that deviates from the typical singular form of a fryum
middle-breakage: crack or break within the structure of the fryum. The break can be seen as a distinct separation or gap disrupting the uniformity of the fryum

normal: depict typical elbow macaroni pasta pieces, which appear to be well-formed and consistent in shape. They exhibit a smooth, curved surface with a uniform golden-yellow color.
chip-around-edge-and-corner: small piece missing from the edge of the macaroni, giving it an uneven contour. It's typically noticeable at the outermost part of the curved surface
different-colour-spot: presence of a distinct reddish or purplish spot on one or more macaroni pieces. The spot contrasts noticeably with the natural color of the macaroni
middle-breakage-small-scratches: noticeable hole or breakage in the middle part of the macaroni. It disrupts the regular cylindrical shape and creates a void that is evident when viewed from any angle
similar-colour-spots: a spot that blends in with the macaroni's natural hue, making it harder to detect at first glance. The spot usually appears slightly darker or lighter but maintains a similar color tone to the surrounding pasta
small-cracks: fine, linear cracks or scratches along the surface of the macaroni. These imperfections are generally shallow but can be observed running along the length or circumference of the piece

normal: the macaroni pieces exhibit a smooth and uniform yellowish color throughout. The edges are neatly rounded without any chips or cracks. There are no discolored spots or surface scratches present. Each piece maintains a consistent shape and texture with a slightly glossy finish.
color-spot-similar-to-the-object: a spot that blends with the macaroni's natural yellowish color, creating a lighter, whitish or yellowish patch. These spots are subtle and may almost merge with the macaroni's surface tone
different-color-spot: a discolored area with a dark or purplish tint on one or more macaroni pieces. These spots stand out against the natural yellow color of the macaroni
small-chip-around-edge: visible breakage or missing sections at the edges of the macaroni pieces. These chips or cracks can be seen as irregularities in the otherwise smooth cylindrical shape of the macaroni
small-scratches: thin and shallow lines or abrasions running along the surface of the macaroni

normal: the HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor Module PCB includes 2 cylindrical metal-can transducers (Receiver and Transmitter) placed horizontally, a 4-pin header, and a rectangular silver crystal oscillator. The term 'pins' refers exclusively to the 4-pin header connectors.
bent: one or more of the 4-pin header connector pins being misaligned significantlty
melt: ccumulation of silver-colored solder material, usually appearing as blobs or excess spillover
missing: one or both cylindrical transducers or one or multiple pins are absent
scratch: visible scratch lines on the pdb surface, specially in the PCB board

normal: the HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor Module PCB includes 3 integrated circuits (left: U3, center: U2, right: U1) with multiple pins, a 4-pin header (VCC, Trig, Echo, GND) centered at the edge, several SMD resistors and capacitors arrayed in rows around the ICs, and 4 circular mounting holes at the corners. The blue PCB has clear labels ('HC-SR04', U1, U2, U3, labeled resistors, and capacitors). The term 'pins' refers exclusively to the 4-pin header at the top edge.
bent: one or more of the 4-pin header connector pins being misaligned or bent away from their original straight position
melt: accumulation of silver-colored solder material, usually appearing as blobs or excess spillover
missing: a component such as pins, circuits, or resistors is visibly absent from the board
scratch: visible scratch lines on the surface of the PCB board

normal: includes 2 LEDs (transparent IR emitter and black IR receiver), a 3-pin header, an integrated circuit (U1), a blue potentiometer (3362) for sensitivity adjustment, and several SMD resistors and capacitors arrayed around the IC. The term 'pins' refers exclusively to the 3-pin header and white and black LEDs on the sides of the board.
bent: one of pins or LEDs in either sides of the board are visibly bent or misaligned
melt: accumulation of silver-colored solder material, characterized by silver-colored blobs or smears on the board
missing: certain components like resistors, capacitors, pins, or LEDs are absent
scratch: visible scratch lines or marks on the surface of the PCB board

normal: the TP4056 Lithium Battery Charging Module PCB includes a micro USB port at the left edge, 4 connection pads labeled IN+, IN-, BAT+, and BAT- at the corners, an integrated circuit (U1) near the bottom center with multiple pins, several SMD resistors and capacitors around the IC, and 2 LEDs (CHRG, DONE) indicating charging status near the center top. The blue PCB has clear labels for component positions and connections. Check for secure attachment and alignment of the USB port, IC, resistors, capacitors, and LEDs, straight and firmly soldered connection pads, and legible markings
extra: presence of an unwanted object, such as dirt, dust, or an extra circuit component, located on the PCB
missing: characterized by the absence of one or more essential components such as pins, circuits, or resistors

normal: is uniformly shaped with smooth, intact edges and corners. Its surface is free of any scratches, chips, or uneven marks and lacks colored spots or blemishes
burnt: characterized by an orangish-brownish patch that appears scorched or burnt
corner-and-edge-breakage: visible breakage or chipping, located around the corners or along the edges
different-colour-spot: characterized by a small, distinct dark spot on the fryum
similar-colour-spot: characterized by a small, light-colored spot that blends closely with the fryum's natural hue
small-scratches: characterized by thin and shallow lines or abrasions running along the surface of the fryum
stuck-together: characterized by two or more fryums being adhered to each other, forming clusters
